note: FNS 1063.1 is entirely a QC review procedure. It instructs QC reviewers on how to evaluate earned income during the first and second effective months of a certification action using Comparison I (verify sample month income) and Comparison II (correct EW worksheet for errors, then apply AORD change logic). The concepts of Comparison I vs II allotment tests, error thresholds, AORD change-inclusion timing, and correcting EW worksheets are all QC audit methodology with no caseworker equivalent. The underlying caseworker policies this section references — income determination at certification, prospective budgeting, income conversion, and change processing — are covered in separate FNS sections and have corresponding OLG coverage (e.g., 'Types of Earned Income > Income from Steady Employment', 'Entering, Changing, and Ending Earned Income in BEACON', interim report processing procedures). No OLG content about QC comparison tests or error determination was found, which is expected since QC procedures are not part of the staff guide.
